85  def create_program(self, name: str, description: str, python_code: str, blockly_code: str = '') -> str:
86  has_blockly = blockly_code != ''
87  program_id = str(uuid4())
88  response = system_api_client.add_program(id_=program_id,
89  name=name,
90  description=description,
91  has_blockly=has_blockly)
92  if not response.success:
93  raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to create program "{name}": {response.detail}')
94  self.__python_manager.write(program_id, python_code)
95  if has_blockly:
96  self.__blockly_manager.write(program_id, blockly_code)
97 
98  self.__programs[program_id] = self.get(program_id)
99  return program_id

101  def delete_program(self, program_id: str) -> None:
102  program = self.__programs.get(program_id)
103  response = system_api_client.delete_program(program_id)
104  if not response.success:
105  raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to delete program "{program_id}": {response.detail}')
106  self.__python_manager.remove(program_id)
107  self.__programs.pop(program_id)
108  if program and program['has_blockly']:
109  self.__blockly_manager.remove(program_id)

111  def update_program(self, program_id: str, name: str, description: str, python_code: str, blockly_code: str) -> None:
112  has_blockly = blockly_code != ''

117  if not response.success:
118  raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to update program "{program_id}": {response.detail}')
119  self.__python_manager.write(program_id, python_code, overwrite_allowed=True)
120  if has_blockly:
121  self.__blockly_manager.write(program_id, blockly_code, overwrite_allowed=True)
122  self.__programs.pop(program_id)

131  def get(self, program_id: str) -> ProgramDict:
132  """
133  Retrieve a program by doing a request to the database and by reading the files on the system
134  :param program_id: the wanted program's id
135  :type program_id: str
136  :return: The program information
137  :rtype: ProgramDict
138  """
139  response = system_api_client.get_program(program_id)
140  if not response.success:
141  raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to get program "{program_id}": {response.detail}')
142  db_program = response.data
143  db_program['python_code'] = self.__python_manager.read(program_id)
144  db_program['blockly_code'] = self.__blockly_manager.read(program_id) if db_program['has_blockly'] else ''
145  return db_program

147  def get_all(self) -> List[ProgramDict]:
148  """
149  Returns all the programs.
150  This method is costly as it calls the database and the system files multiple times.
151  Prefer using the programs property
152  :return: The programs information
153  :rtype: List[ProgramDict]
154  """
155  response = system_api_client.get_programs()
156  if not response.success:
157  rospy.logerr(f'Failed to get all programs: {response.detail}')
158  return []
159  return [self.get(db_program['id']) for db_program in response.data]
